newsitem.title: UK: U.K.'s SIB to examine electronic trade rules - FT.
newsitem.headline: U.K.'s SIB to examine electronic trade rules - FT.

text.p: Britain's leading financial watchdog, the Securities and Investments Board (SIB), is to examine new rules for the introduction of electronic share trading in London, the Financial Times reported on Friday.
The report said the SIB would examine whether proposed rules were unfairly biased in favour of large investment banks.

The Financial Times said the stock exchange would announce later on Friday that it was to carry out further work on the rules for the start of order-driven trading next October before passing them to the SIB for consideration.

The SIB will also consult the Office of Fair Trading, which the newspaper said had already expressed concern about banks being allowed to delay publication of the details of large trades by up to 60 minutes.
